name: Siege Dragon

items.name: Frightful
items.text: A creature who is within 100 feet of a siege dragon at the start of its turn must succeed a DC 39 Will save save or become Frightened 2. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is then temporarily immune to this effect for 24 hours.

items.name: Weapon Mounts
items.text: This vehicle has a weapon mount. At purchase, this weapon mount is initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into the mount requires 3 hours, a successful DC 39 Crafting check check, and an appropriate weapon. The mount can be equipped with a Large or smaller ranged siege weapon.

text: Crafted to appear as a chunky adamantine dragon at a distance, this vehicle is designed to scare civilians and intimidate enemy armies on the battlefield below.
